provenance.notes: Non-power-of-two D72 attention exercises the portable LPQ2 flash family; dimensions divisible by 16 retain the materialized GEMM path.
Measures Attention over a single head with a non-power-of-two head width of 72 and a 512-token sequence.
Four heads at 512 queries (64 query groups) at head dimension 72: midway between the one-head and sixteen-head cases.
Two heads, 512 queries, and head width 80 provide a compact attention case with a non-power-of-two head dimension.
Half-precision twin of the sixteen-head head-dimension-72 case: the same LPQ2 flash class with half storage, where the materialized GEMM keeps its float32 tiles.
Half-precision twin of the twelve-head head-dimension-80 case: the LPQ4 flash class with half storage.
A query length of 32 fills one complete tile at the same KV length, head counts, and dtype as the q31 boundary shape.
Measures Attention over a grouped-query prefill: 32 query heads over 8 key/value heads, 128 queries against a 2048-token cache, head width 128.
Measures Attention over a grouped-query prefill: 32 query heads over 8 key/value heads, 64 queries against a 2048-token cache, head width 128.
Realistic hidden-size-960 attention (16 heads x 60) exercises the path below the rank-4 flash headDim>=64 threshold.
Noncausal float32 attention with four heads, head dimension 64 and 128-token sequences.
Noncausal float32 attention with four heads, head dimension 256 and 128-token sequences.
Long keys (512) with 128 cluster blocks separate key-loop length from total block count in masked d64 attention.
Short keys (256) with 384 cluster blocks separate total block count from key-loop length in masked d64 attention.
